$comment_design_plugins: Merged into .claude/settings.json by /core:new-project for projects with a web UI (skipped for backend-only). Declares two third-party design plugins: impeccable (pbakaus/impeccable — anti-slop detector hooks + /impeccable commands) and styles-library (lbtbly/styles-library — visual direction picker; PRIVATE repo: install succeeds only with GitHub access to it). On repo trust Claude Code prompts to install both; autoUpdate:true opts into background updates (third-party marketplaces default to off; updates land on next launch or /reload-plugins). Impeccable's hooks need node >= 22 on PATH and degrade gracefully without it. Remove keys to drop a plugin.
